primary_question: Does a conservative content readout add source-held-out utility beyond center position when the target is separated into generic value, ongoing action, result/reaction, and information dependency?
hypothesis: R43 lost utility because a result-biased video-text score replaced useful ongoing-action frames and ignored audio or preceding/following state. A small readout that keeps ongoing value separate and gates context-dependent evidence should be safer than direct event-completion rank replacement.
competitive_explanations: The labels are too unstable or source-selected to identify a transferable target; any apparent gain will disappear under source-held-out evaluation.
The relevant content is visible but current low-dimensional features cannot represent it; a larger temporal encoder would then be justified only after the readout test.
Center position already captures the official prior and content residuals add mostly false positives; the safe baseline should remain unchanged.

data_contract.unit_of_split: original source video and source/session, never random frames
data_contract.labels: V1.3 exports preserved per project and per frame; overlap kept as repeated observations, not averaged ground truth
data_contract.unknown_policy: unknown, missing dependency, and unavailable audio remain masked; never recoded to zero
data_contract.official_test: inference only; no labels, pseudo labels, human relabeling, or teacher distillation
data_contract.spatial: do not train from free-ratio annotation boxes; keep B3 fixed for any later candidate

features: static RGB quality and composition proxies

evaluation.split: leave-one-source-out; duplicate windows from a source stay in the same fold
evaluation.readout: ordinal or soft-label linear/low-rank head with fixed regularization; report per-source macro metrics
evaluation.screening_gate: content arm must improve the held-out source median and have a positive paired source effect in the predeclared comparison; otherwise stop before a new encoder
evaluation.promotion_gate: only a frozen function with public source-held-out practical gain, no unresolved label-contract issue, exact round(0.85*N) budget, unchanged B3 boxes, and total inference parameters <=9B may become an upload candidate
evaluation.official_claim: only a user-uploaded ZIP SHA bound to an official score can establish competition improvement

resource_budget.small_gpu_probe: <=45 minutes after nvidia-smi; no formal training in this phase
resource_budget.formal_training: not launched; if promoted, communicate measured profile first, use timeout 11h50m and recoverable checkpoints, expected <=10.5h
resource_budget.human_work: none required to start; optional 30-60 frame second-account blind audit only if the diagnostic result is near the promotion gate

stop_rules: gain exists only on the same-account overlap or one source
content score needs an unconstrained replacement of center frames to appear better
a proposed candidate changes spatial boxes, budget, or test supervision at the same time

diagnostic_001.finding: D2 local state descriptors reduce held-out generic-grade MAE, but neither phase nor dependency targets improve; low-level audio features do not provide a stable increment
diagnostic_001.next: fit a capacity-limited local-state residual with center frozen; keep audio-only branch paused
